lines.speaker: enemy
lines.pinyin: shān shàng kāi shǐ xià xuě le
lines.en: It’s starting to snow in the mountains.
lines.fr: Il commence à neiger en montagne.

lines.speaker: player
lines.pinyin: tái wān yě huì xià xuě ma
lines.en: Does it snow in Taiwan too?

lines.speaker: enemy
lines.pinyin: zhǐ yǒu gāo shān cái yǒu xuě
lines.en: Only the high mountains get snow.
lines.fr: Seules les hautes montagnes ont de la neige.

lines.speaker: player
lines.pinyin: wǒ hǎo xiǎng qù kàn xuě
lines.en: I really want to go see snow.
lines.fr: J’ai très envie d’aller voir la neige.

lines.speaker: enemy
lines.pinyin: nà yào dài hòu wài tào
